jobs_results.title: Ingeniero/a informático Junior - SW Producción (MES)
jobs_results.description:
Segula Tecnologías precisa incorporar un/a INGENIERO/A SISTEMAS, con algo de experiencia en software de planificación de la producción (MES), para importante proyecto relacionado con el sector de la automoción, y ubicado en Vitoria.

Funciones:

• Traccionar la implementación de un sistema nuevo de pilotaje de la secuenciación de los pedidos a producción.

Requisitos:

• Ingeniero/a Técnico - Superior: Perfil informático, telecomunicación, organización, etc.

• Experiencia de al menos 6 meses con sistemas de secuenciación de pedidos de producción.

• Experiencia en planta productiva.

• Ciertos conocimientos de PLCs, Bases de datos, SQL, etc

• Valorable conocimientos de GP .

• Valorable experiencia en el sector de la automoción.

• Nivel alto de inglés.

Let´s shape the future together!

Desde SEGULA TECHNOLOGIES estamos buscando a gente... como tú. La compañía ha experimentado un rápido crecimiento en los últimos años y actualmente estamos presentes en más de 30 países con más de 15.000 empleados/as.

Acompañamos a nuestros clientes en todas las etapas del ciclo de vida del producto. SEGULA TECHNOLOGIES cuenta con un amplio equipo de expertos/as de ingeniería diseño, modelado y simulación, así como tecnologías digitales.

Trabajamos en un ambiente inclusivo y respetuoso, donde todas las personas son valoradas y tienen igualdad de oportunidades para desarrollar su potencial

jobs_results.title: Software Development Engineer, Invoice By Amazon
jobs_results.description:
Description

Invoice By Amazon (IBA) team is on a journey to establish their single supplier invoice product as the default experience for all Amazon Business (AB) customers in Europe. With our product rapidly expanding across other marketplaces (launched India and plans to launch in Canada), our long term vision is to continue providing new features that facilitate the procurement process for all our business customers around the world.

As more and more customers adopt the IBA experience, we face increasingly complex architectural challenges. We are currently directing our efforts towards scaling our systems and reducing parity gaps in order to provide a seamless experience for all our customers.

We are looking for self-motivated software engineers that are enthusiastic about learning how complex backend systems work and producing innovative solutions to our current architectural problems.

Key job responsibilities
• Develop deep understanding of ordering platforms.
• Design and... modify scalable software architecture of backend systems.
• Work independently to deliver and maintain medium sized features.
• Apply software engineering best practices to the development life cycle (incremental delivery, coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, operations...).
• Engage in continuous prioritisation efforts to balance out fast paced business requirements with long term technical investments.

A day in the life
• Supporting teammates through collaboration and mentoring.
• Shipping and reviewing Java and AWS CDK code for new features on IBA systems.
• Driving improvements on team-level code quality, process efficiency and knowledge sharing.
• Troubleshooting a wide variety of customer issues all across AB ordering domain.
• Focusing on Operational Excellence (development processes, monitoring, code deployment, automated testing, dashboarding...).
• Work with partner teams to enable key IBA behaviours on their platforms.

About The Team

IBA Core team is a two-pizza team that owns the integrations with ordering systems that enable IBA orders to be processed during checkout, fulfilled correctly and returned properly if needed.

Because of the horizontal nature of the IBA product, engineers on our team work regularly with the owners of foundational platforms across ordering lifecycle. This poses a great challenge in terms of cooperating with stakeholders from very diverse domains, but comes with equally great opportunities to have a big impact, grow and innovate.

We are open to hiring candidates to work out of one of the following locations:

Madrid, M, ESP

Basic Qualifications
• Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers
• Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
• Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Java, C++, or C# including object-oriented design
• Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
• Good English communication skills. Spanish is not required.

Preferred Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
• Interest and/or experience in one of the following:
• Distributed Systems
• Microservices
• Frameworks
• Amazon Web Services (AWS), S3, DynamoDB, AWS Lambda
• Fast-paced business environment
• Agile software development
• International software development

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build. Protecting your privacy and the security of your data is a longstanding top priority for Amazon. Please consult our Privacy Notice (https://www.amazon.jobs/en/privacy_page) to know more about how we collect, use and transfer the personal data of our candidates.

Company - Amazon Spain Services, S.L.U.

Job ID: A2607894
